title: It was great the first 4 boxes
text: This was super cool when I first subscribed, however now products are repeating. In the  most recent box, two products are repeats from the last box, three are repeats from last season, and all the masks are repeats. I was under the impression this box would do new products each season. Pretty disappointed, I was really looking forward to new products and now just have more of what I've already tried. Only one of the items had made it into my normal rotation last time I got it so that sucks.
label: negative
